pages.title: A – D
pages.body:
- **Associative property:** (a + b) + c = a + (b + c) and (a × b) × c = a × (b × c).
- **Bias:** Anything in the way data are collected that makes the results unfair or misleading.
- **Circumcentre:** The point where the perpendicular bisectors of a triangle's sides meet; centre of the circumcircle.
- **Circumcircle:** The circle that passes through all three vertices of a triangle.
- **Commission:** Payment to an agent calculated as a percentage of the value of sales.
- **Commutative property:** a + b = b + a and a × b = b × a.
- **Congruent:** Exactly the same shape and size.
- **Dependent events:** Events where the outcome of one changes the probability of the other.
- **Depreciation:** A fall in the value of an item over time.

pages.title: D – N
pages.body:
- **Discount:** A reduction in the price of an item.
- **Enlargement:** A transformation that changes the size of a shape by a scale factor from a centre.
- **Histogram:** A graph of grouped continuous data in which the bars touch.
- **Incentre:** The point where the angle bisectors of a triangle meet; centre of the incircle.
- **Incircle:** The circle inside a triangle that touches all three sides.
- **Irrational number:** A number that cannot be written as a fraction of integers, e.g. √2, π.
- **Modal class:** The class with the highest frequency in grouped data.
- **Net:** A flat shape that can be folded to make a solid.
- **NHIL:** National Health Insurance Levy, a percentage charged on goods and services in Ghana.

pages.title: P – S
pages.body:
- **Parallel vectors:** Vectors that are scalar multiples of each other.
- **Pension right:** The percentage of the average of the best three years' salaries paid as pension.
- **Perpendicular vectors:** Vectors at 90° to each other; for (a, b) and (c, d), ac + bd = 0.
- **Position vector:** The vector from the origin to a point.
- **Premium:** The amount paid for insurance cover.
- **Rational number:** A number that can be written as a/b, where a and b are integers and b ≠ 0.
- **Scale factor:** The number by which lengths are multiplied in an enlargement.
- **Similar:** Having equal angles and proportional sides.
- **Simple interest:** Interest calculated only on the original principal: I = PRT ÷ 100.

pages.title: S – V
pages.body:
- **Simultaneous equations:** Two or more equations solved together for the same unknowns.
- **SSNIT:** Social Security and National Insurance Trust, which runs Ghana's basic pension scheme.
- **Subject of a formula:** The variable that stands alone on one side of a formula.
- **Surd:** An irrational root such as √2 or √5.
- **Surface area:** The total area of all the faces of a solid.
- **VAT:** Value Added Tax, a tax charged on the sale of goods and services.
